topic: A person learns their apartment building is going condo
text: Rain's steady drum on the old fire escape. Beats out the rhythm of the city, like it's whispering secrets. Got a call from a former friend, or maybe acquaintance's better, about the apartment building. Some suit's turning it into condos, they say. Figures. They're all frantic, asking what to do. Like I'm the architect of their fate. I listened, nodding like I cared, suggested they check the lease, lawyer up, maybe band together.(phone rings) Another soul in the rain, needing a life raft. Can only do so much. The week's been a series of these, each one a testament to how thin the veneer of security really is.
